verdict: Meta is delivering strong leads; Google spend needs tracking fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 86 leads entirely from Meta at $36.45 per lead — and the pace accelerated sharply in the final days of the window, confirming real momentum there. At the same time, Google Ads consumed $2,332.84 over the same period with zero recorded conversions; this is a confirmed conversion tracking failure, not a campaign issue, and fixing it is the immediate priority. On the pipeline side, 86 leads arrived but no appointments or won opportunities are showing in the system, which points to a follow-up or intake gap that we're actively reviewing. Next period you can expect Google tracking to be restored, giving a clearer read on what that spend is actually producing, alongside new creative and landing pages rolling out by end of August.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
cost per lead on Meta — down 71% from the prior week
spent on Google Ads this period with conversion tracking confirmed broken

watch_item.issue: Google Ads conversion tracking is not recording any results, making $2,332.84 in spend unverifiable.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being repaired and an offline conversion import is scheduled live by end of August so every dollar is accounted for.
